name: labs/eta-systems__labor-gpib
title: Rohde & Schwarz NGMO2 channel A
intro: Rohde & Schwarz NGMO2 channel A, adapted from eta-systems/labor-gpib. It reads `identity` and `status_byte`; sets `voltage_setpoint`, `current_limit`, `measurement_interval`, `averaging_samples` and 5 more; runs `measure_voltage`, `measure_current`, `output_off` and `scpi_rst`. `measure_voltage`: measure a DC or RMS voltage on a declared channel or terminal pair and return the value with its sampling timestamp and measurement range. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
